card.title: Impossible Specialist
card.instruction: Approach the strange situation with precise technical confidence, insisting that its impossible details require exact terminology and proper handling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your ghost has reverse haunting: fear of occupied houses. We'll relocate it under a reassuring sheet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got a sheet with little houses printed on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use a plain one. We mustn't transport the trigger with the patient.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The plain one's fitted. It keeps pulling the ghost into a ball.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's involuntary apparition compression. Release the corners separately; we need it ghost-shaped for the doorway.
